person_note: The controlling narration is third-person limited, centered on Kiela. Numerous long Goodreads passages narrate her externally as “she,” and independent Tier A excerpts establish the same pattern in both Chapter One and an interior chapter. Scattered first-person sentences in event quotes are Kiela’s unquoted or italicized direct thoughts, while other “I,” “we,” and “you” forms occur in dialogue, maxims, or authorial paratext; none constitutes a sustained first- or second-person base section. No credible structural evidence suggests alternating narration.
